title: Midday Digest: Weigman out, 5⭐ freshman Henderson starts for Houston (Sat Nov 21)
parts:
🕐 MIDDAY UPDATE

🔄 QB CHANGE AT HOUSTON

Conner Weigman | QB | Houston | SR, 5⭐ | #5 QB (preseason: #8)

Ruled out at West Virginia after pregame warmups (via ESPN). He's been dealing with a right shoulder injury suffered Nov. 13 at Colorado (via Houston Chronicle).

🆕 Keisean Henderson | QB | Houston | FR, 5⭐ | #20 QB (preseason: #54)

The true freshman gets his first career start in Weigman's place (via ESPN, WV MetroNews).

He'd appeared in 2 games before today, so this is the first real look.

Are you buying the debut? 👇
